name: ObjectVerbs
description: Represents the collection of OLE verbs for the specified OLE object. OLE verbs are the operations supported by an OLE object. Commonly used OLE verbs are "play" and "edit."
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(2).Shapes(1).OLEFormat

    For Each v In .ObjectVerbs

        MsgBox v

    Next

End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from the specified ObjectVerbs collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single object in the collection to be returned.
